1 زَغَلَهُ , aor.
زَغَلَ , (K,) inf. n. زَغْلٌ, (TA,) He, or it, poured it out, or forth, with an impetus, or with force. (K. [See also 4.]) And He, or it, spirted it forth; (K;) as also ↓ ازغلهُ . (TA.) You say, الشَّرَابَ ↓ أَزْغَلْتُ I spirted forth the wine, or beverage. (JK.) And زَغَلَتِ المَزَادَةُ مِنْ عَزْلَائِهَا The leathern water-bag poured [or spirted] forth
from its spout. (TA.) And زَغَلَتِ النَّاقَةُ بِبَوْلِهَا: see 4. ―
-b2- زَغَلَ الأُمَّ He (a kid, TA) sucked the mother: (K, TA:) [and رَغَلَ is a dial. var. thereof:] so says Er-Riyáshee: or, as in the L, زَغَلَتِ البَهْمَةُ أُمَّهَا the young lamb or hid overpowered its mother and sucked her. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
